NETMESSAGE:Ancient hologram: As you may have noticed, we've finally reached our destination. 
An 'M' class planet orbiting a red dwarf in star system X1478. 
We've detected mutiple subspace distress signals across the planet. 
I've locked onto the strongest signal, we're going to beam you down to a nearby location.
Translation:
古老的全息影像：你们可能已经注意到，我们终于到达了目的地。
一颗围绕X1478恒星系中红矮星运行的“M”级行星。
我们探测到该行星上有多个子空间求救信号。
我已锁定最强信号，将把你们传送到附近地点。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Ancient hologram: Activating transporters... ...now!
Translation: 古老的全息影像：启动传送器…………现在！

Title: NETMESSAGE:CryoKeen (radio): CryoKeen here. I know we don't see eye to eye but I promise things are different now. \nMaybe we can help each other... if you can find me...
Translation: CryoKeen（无线电）：这里是CryoKeen。我知道我们意见不合，但我保证现在情况不同了。\n也许我们可以互相帮助……如果你能找得到我……
